full_judgment: 2. The facts, relevant for disposal of the case in brief, are that the respondent obtained Bachelor of Arts decree in 1987. The petitioner No. 1 published advertisement (নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি) in the Daily `Dainik Bangla for the post of Clerk-cum-Typist and in response to the said advertisement the petitioner applied for the said post by filing application on 07.02.1994 and the respondent was selected by the interview committee on 15.04.1994 and his appointment letter was issued on 16.04.1994 and he started performing his duty as Clerk-cum-Typist. The petitioner No. 1 by his memo dated 25.08.2001 wrote to the petitioner No. 4, Director General, secondary and Higher Secondary Education, Dhaka for regularizing the service of the respondent. The M.A.S. Superintendent, Local and Revenue Audit Directorate, Dhaka petitioner No. 3 submitted an audit objection without mentioning date against the college of the petitioner No. 1 alleging the illegal appointment of the respondent and another by erasing the description of the post in the clearance certificate at serial No. 1 and inserting two posts of Lower Division Clerk-cum-Typist in place of Mechanic-cum-Electrician.
